Mismatched-person null (one person's prediction vs another person's BOLD, same condition, 7 ROIs): EC +0.002 (SD 0.087), EO +0.005 (SD 0.087)

Paired differences (full model, 7 ROIs):

- Δ new-site statistics vs VU statistics, eyes closed: +0.002 (-0.001 to +0.004), 18 of 28 people
- Δ eyes closed vs eyes open (new-site statistics): +0.087 (+0.029 to +0.144), 19 of 28 people
- Δ trained within ds006040 vs transferred, eyes closed: -0.000 (-0.018 to +0.018), 15 of 28 people
- Δ pooled vs within-ds006040, eyes closed: +0.010 (-0.004 to +0.024), 15 of 28 people

Best regions (eyes closed, transferred): Heschl’s gyrus 0.28, Paracentral lobule superior 0.27, Callosomarginal sulcus 0.27, Inferior occipital gyrus 0.27, Central sulcus 0.26, Thalamus 0.26

Worst regions: Superior frontal sulcus 0.09, Angular gyrus superior 0.10, Angular gyrus inferior 0.11, Superior frontal gyrus 0.11

| Global signal | alpha | -0.258 at 9 s | -0.158 at 9 s | -0.107 at 9 s |

| Global signal | theta | -0.152 at 17 s | -0.127 at 13 s | -0.136 at 9 s |
| Cuneus | alpha | -0.250 at 9 s | -0.126 at 7 s | -0.080 at 11 s |
| Cuneus | beta | -0.234 at 9 s | -0.116 at 9 s | +0.098 at 3 s |
| Cuneus | theta | -0.139 at 11 s | -0.103 at 11 s | +0.126 at 3 s |

| Thalamus | theta | +0.135 at 3 s | -0.081 at 13 s | -0.118 at 9 s |

## Arousal-monitor prototype on ds006040

| Condition | Runs | r predicted vs measured global BOLD, offline | Streaming (causal) | Streaming vs offline agreement |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Eyes closed | 28 | 0.255 (0.198 to 0.311) | 0.263 (0.205 to 0.321) | 0.932 |
| Eyes open | 28 | 0.171 (0.106 to 0.236) | 0.161 (0.097 to 0.225) | 0.962 |

Median compute time per fMRI volume (streaming, one CPU core): 3 ms.

QC validity across runs (Spearman ρ):

| EEG-derived measure | vs measured global-signal swing (raw SD) | vs how predictable the run is (r offline) | vs head motion (mean FD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Arousal fluctuation (SD of predicted global BOLD) | +0.50 (p = 8.2e-05) | +0.42 (p = 0.0012) | +0.32 (p = 0.017) |
| Vigilance-index SD | -0.04 (p = 0.77) | -0.04 (p = 0.77) | +0.05 (p = 0.72) |
